params.name: custom-api-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the Custom API.

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The current offset by number of records, not pages. Offset is zero-based. The maximum records you can offset is 10,000. If no page size is set, the [page length](/docs/api/settings/settings-introduction#page-length) store setting is used.

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: The maximum number of records per page for this response. You can set this value up to 100. If no page size is set, the [page length](/docs/api/settings/settings-introduction#page-length) store setting is used.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter attributes. For more information, see the [Filtering](/guides/Getting-Started/filtering) section.

params.name: sort
params.description: Specifies the order in which Custom Fields will be returned. For more information, see [Sorting](/guides/Getting-Started/sorting).

items.docs:
Retrieves a list of Custom Fields

## Filtering
The following operators and attributes are available for [filtering](/guides/Getting-Started/filtering) Custom Fields:

| Attribute     | Operators                     | Example                                       |
|---------------|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| `id`          | `lt`,`le`,`eq`,`gt`,`ge`,`in` | `eq(id,859aeba1-03c2-4822-bd4c-89afce93d7eb)` |
| `created_at`  | `lt`,`le`,`eq`,`gt`,
